key_insight: Linear probes and standard sparse autoencoders can falsely suggest conceptic structure but fail to support compositional generalisation when representations use superposition: projecting a higher‑dimensional concept space into a lower‑dimensional activation space can break linear separability, so probe success does not imply usable, compositional latent factors.
problem_solved: Explains why common analysis and representation methods (linear probes, per‑sample sparse autoencoding) are unreliable measures and mechanisms for compositional generalisation under superposition, and identifies what kinds of inference/decoding are needed to recover usable concepts.
method: Theoretical analysis: model concept encoding as a projection from a higher‑dimensional concept space into a lower‑dimensional activation space and show linear decision boundaries need not survive projection.
Empirical comparison: evaluate linear probes and sparse autoencoders versus per‑sample iterative inference / decoding methods (leveraging compressed‑sensing style guarantees) on compositional tasks.
Diagnostics and recommendations: identify failure modes and advocate for per‑sample decoding/inference or richer probes that reconstruct latent structure rather than relying only on linear readouts.
impact: Practitioners should not equate linear probe accuracy with recoverable, compositional concepts: to build or evaluate models that generalise compositionally, use reconstruction/decoding or iterative inference methods that can undo superposition instead of relying solely on linear probes.
visual_elements: Diagram: high‑dimensional concept vectors projected into a low‑dim activation space showing a linear decision boundary in concept space becoming nonlinear after projection.
Bar/line chart: performance comparison on compositional generalisation tasks (linear probes and sparse autoencoders vs per‑sample iterative inference).
Flow schematic: sparse autoencoder pipeline vs per‑sample iterative decoding pipeline highlighting where recovery fails/succeeds.
Icon set: compressed‑sensing symbol, probe icon (magnifying glass), and a broken vs intact composition symbol to summarise failure mode and fix.
paper_title: Stop Probing, Start Coding: Why Linear Probes and Sparse Autoencoders Fail at Compositional Generalisation
paper_authors: Vitória Barin Pacela, Shruti Joshi, Isabela Camacho, Simon Lacoste-Julien, David Klindt
